# Spain: comparison of supply-shock proxy specifications

```{r}
extract_supply_irf <- function(VAR_data, specification) {
  VAR_data$irfs %>%
    dplyr::filter(confi_type == "msw", confi_level == 0.68,
      type == "point") %>%
    dplyr::select(variable, horizon, value) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Specification = specification)
}

benchmark_variables <- VAR_supply_pc$irfs %>%
  dplyr::filter(confi_type == "msw", confi_level == 0.68,
    type == "point") %>%
  dplyr::pull(variable) %>%
  unique()

irf_supply_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  extract_supply_irf(VAR_wind, "Wind supply proxy"),
  extract_supply_irf(VAR_supply_pc, "Benchmark supply proxy"),
  extract_supply_irf(VAR_supply_pc_wedge, "Wedge supply proxy")
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(variable %in% benchmark_variables) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Specification = factor(Specification, levels = c(
      "Wind supply proxy", "Benchmark supply proxy", "Wedge supply proxy")),
    Variable = factor(variable, levels = benchmark_variables,
      labels = get_irf_labels(benchmark_variables))
  )

wind_delta_comparison_plot <- ggplot(
  irf_supply_comparison,
  aes(horizon, value, colour = Specification, linetype = Specification)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey55") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Wind supply proxy" = "#238B45",
    "Benchmark supply proxy" = "#08519C",
    "Wedge supply proxy" = "#CB181D")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    "Wind supply proxy" = "solid",
    "Benchmark supply proxy" = "dashed",
    "Wedge supply proxy" = "dotdash")) +
  labs(title = "Spain: electricity supply shock",
    subtitle = "Comparison of proxy specifications",
    x = "Months after shock", y = "Response",
    colour = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

wind_delta_comparison_plot

ggsave(
  "C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/Overleaf_elec/images/macro/irf_wind_delta_supply_demand_spain.png",
  plot = wind_delta_comparison_plot,
  width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300
)
```
